description: Separate fast PR correctness validation from the coverage floor. Pull requests must run audit, doc tests, and the full non-instrumented all-features workspace suite with the bounded four-worker setting. Pushes to main must retain the full cargo-llvm-cov threshold, JSON artifact, and badge behavior. Do not run coverage on pull_request. Prove workflow syntax, local fast-gate parity, and GitHub Actions behavior on the resulting PR.
title: CI: run coverage on main instead of pull requests
